create_wavespeed_text_to_image: create a WavespeedAITextToImageTask to generate images from text prompts via the Wavespeed AI API
create_wavespeed_text_to_video: create a WavespeedAITextToVideoTask to generate videos from text prompts via the Wavespeed AI API
create_wavespeed_image_to_image: create a WavespeedAIImageToImageTask to transform images using a prompt and source image via Wavespeed AI
create_wavespeed_image_to_video: create a WavespeedAIImageToVideoTask to generate videos from an input image via the Wavespeed AI API
run_wavespeed_polling: run the WavespeedAITask get_response method to poll and retrieve async task results from Wavespeed AI
